nodes_add.name: Helena Blavatsky and Henry Steel Olcott
nodes_add.note: Founders of the Theosophical Society (New York, 17 Nov 1875); in India from Feb 1879; Adyar from 1882. Blavatsky 1831-1891, Olcott 1832-1907 (henry-olcott is the separate tree node for Olcott alone).

edges_upsert.note: Founded in New York on 17 November 1875 with W. Q. Judge and others; Adyar headquarters from 1882.
Union with the Arya Samaj accepted 22 May 1878 (Theosophical Society of Aryavarta); Dayananda attacked the Theosophists publicly on 26 March 1882.
Through Olcott: Colombo lecture of 1880, then his co-worker and translator.
Gandhi became an associate member of Blavatsky's London lodge in 1891 (Wikipedia).
Reviewed The Secret Doctrine 1889, met Blavatsky in Paris, became a favoured pupil and co-editor of Lucifer.

glossary.def: The Five Precepts taken by Buddhist laity in Sri Lanka; Olcott and Blavatsky took them at Weliwatta, near Galle, on 19 May 1880.
In Blavatsky's teaching, a hidden hierarchy of adepts said to oversee human evolution and to inspire the Theosophical Society; also called Mahatmas.

blavatsky-olcott: Blavatsky birth, Saratov, 1849, New York 8 July 1873, met Olcott 1874, Isis Unveiled, Secret Doctrine contents, Theosophist Oct 1879, Hodgson/March 1885 departure, London 1887, death 8 May 1891, Gandhi 1891 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helena_Blavatsky
Birth date, claimed study in India and Tibet presented as claim, works 1877-1889, death -> https://www.britannica.com/biography/Helena-Blavatsky (fetched via search result)
Olcott birth, Bombay 16 Feb 1879, 19 May 1880 precepts, Catechism 1881, flag 1885, colleges 1886-92, Chicago 1893, death 17 Feb 1907 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henry_Steel_Olcott

17 May 1880 Galle, Colombo branch 17 June 1880, Catechism 24 July 1881 endorsed by Sumangala, 14 beliefs Adyar 8-12 Jan 1891, Dharmapala, Gunananda/Panadura -> https://bps.lk/olib/wh/wh281_Kirthisinghe_Amarasuriya_Colonel-Olcott--Service-to-Buddhism.html
Adyar estate 1882, Japan 1889 fourteen propositions, Society aims -> https://www.theosophical.org/files/resources/articles/ColonelHenryOlcott.pdf
Arya Samaj union 22 May 1878, Dayananda attack 26 March 1882 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theosophical_Society_of_the_Arya_Samaj
Ceylon 1880, Buddhist schools, Young Men's Buddhist Association, 1884 London -> https://newworldencyclopedia.org/entry/Henry_Steel_Olcott

issues: blavatsky-olcott.mdx: placed in Part 11 (Olcott's Buddhist work and Dharmapala) although the Theosophical Society node sits in Part 12; author may prefer Part 2 (Is all religion one?).
blavatsky-olcott.mdx: Olcott's birthday/arrival dates differ slightly between sources (Dec 1878 departure, Feb 1879 arrival; Wikipedia 'settled 1879', Theosophical.org '1878').
blavatsky-olcott.mdx: the flag committee date (1885) is Wikipedia's; the BPS essay credits Olcott with the design. Text says he advised the committee.
blavatsky-olcott.mdx: Dayananda attack date 26 March 1882 from Wikipedia; no second source read.

blavatsky-olcott.mdx: Panchama schools, the Adyar Library and Olcott's Hindu-reform work were not supported by any source read and are left out; the 'effect on Indian reform' is covered only through the Arya Samaj union and Gandhi's 1891 membership.
